about: The readability check (docs/ops/checks/README.md › readability; his calls 2026-10-14: WCAG AA 4.5:1 for all readable text, 3:1 large; Glass at its defaults and at each slider's two ends).

Run it with `node docs/ops/checks/readability.mjs` (all looks, then the Glass slider ends, then the report). Each `read` step scores every text box on screen against the pixels behind it (scripts/readability.mjs).
Every card is on screen in one of the first four shots; the last four are the overlays: the Compass, the quick panel, the toasts and a hover hint.

shots.about: Max at its defaults: Home, Library, Playlists, Search, Now Playing, Queue.
Max with History, Radio, Rewind and Library.
Max, two columns: Diary and Rulez.
The Settings card, every section open, read page by page down the whole list.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('[data-mounted=settings] .set__fold[data-fold][aria-expanded=false]'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 40)); } })()
